17.description: Saskatoon advisory committees can now approve up to $2,000 in spending and must submit annual budgets by October 1 for Council approval, aiming for consistency.

chips.text: A committee member questioned setting budgets for future, reactive committees.
How to develop budgets for ad hoc funding requests from external groups.
Administration will provide background on existing grants before funding requests.

11.description: Saskatoon will provide up to $1,000 in sponsorship to Wild About Saskatoon for the Pollinator Paradise YXE initiative, excluding food and beverage costs. The event is on May 31st at University School.

chips.text: The event is on May 31st from 1 to 4 PM at University School.
Saskatoon Environmental Advisory Committee submitted the sponsorship request.
